title: Rabbi David Tawil: Life Lessons From Pirke Abot- "Growth & Memory"

chapters.title: Introduction and the Question of Forgetfulness
chapters.about: Welcoming participants and introducing the concept of memory and forgetfulness in human life.

chapters.title: The Mishna in Pirkei Avot on Forgetting Torah
chapters.about: Reading and analyzing the Mishna concerning the severe consequences of forgetting Torah knowledge.

chapters.title: The Value of Reviewing Studies
chapters.about: Discussing the importance of review and how perspectives change at different stages of life.

chapters.title: Rabbinic Statements on Reviewing Torah
chapters.about: Examining rabbinic teachings by Rabbi Yehoshua Ben Korha regarding the consequences of not reviewing Torah.

chapters.title: The Three Mitzvot of Reshit and Prioritizing Hashem
chapters.about: Exploring the Midrash about the three mitzvot connected to the word Reshit and how they teach us to put Hashem and others first.

summary: Rabbi Tawil discusses the concept of forgetfulness and memory in relation to human psychology and the study of Torah. He explores the Mishna in Pirkei Avot regarding the severity of forgetting Torah, the importance of reviewing studies, and how focusing on God and others first can guide one's life choices.
questions: Why does the Mishna say that forgetting a single thing from one's Torah study makes a person liable for their life?
What is the difference between naturally forgetting due to human limitations and actively causing oneself to forget?
Why is regular review of Torah study so important for personal growth?
How do the three mitzvot associated with the word Reshit teach us to prioritize Hashem and others?
